verdict: Paid ads went dark this week; restoring them is the immediate priority.
narrative: Meta advertising has been completely offline since approximately September 18 — zero spend and zero paid leads for seven straight days, after averaging more than three leads per day before the stoppage. That blackout is the single reason lead volume dropped 100% week over week and is the focus of the work happening right now. Separately, the 61 opportunities created over the last 28 days have not yet converted to booked or won appointments, which points to a gap in the intake or follow-up process rather than an advertising issue. Ads will be restored as the immediate first step; once volume resumes, follow-up sequencing will be reviewed to make sure incoming leads are being captured properly. Expect lead flow to recover once the Meta account is back on — the 28-day cost-per-lead of $9.28 confirms the channel was working efficiently before the outage.
